title: Multinational mission boosts Tacloban's disaster response

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Pacific Partnership 2026 (PP26), a multinational humanitarian assistance and disaster preparedness mission, has returned to Tacloban City for a 12-day engagement focused on strengthening disaster response, medical cooperation and community resilience. The mission, which began Sept. 18 and will run until Sept. 29, brings together military personnel and civilian experts from the United States, Canada, Germany, Japan, New Zealand and the United Kingdom to work with the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), local officials, nonprofit organizations and Filipino specialists.
